about_the_game:
SHROT is a no-bullshit FPS (boomer shooter) where you and your guns kill aliens, robots, and the degenerates, all for one damn good time!

No “woke” crap. No politics. No propaganda. No filter.

The goal? Simple. You get home from work, crack a beer, start the game, kill everything that moves, and relax.

The name SHROT stands for Shoot, Hit, Reload, Overkill, Terminate. The game cuts out most of the boring cutscenes, keeping you in nonstop combat and pure adrenaline flow.

RETRO SHOOTER. NO CENSORSHIP. JUST PURE ACTION.

You play as a truck driver with a “dad bod” who is Slavic by blood, American by paycheck.
He came to the States to drive trucks and drink beer... usually both at the same time.
Years of treating beer like hydration gave him a belly that enters rooms slightly before he does.
He finds benefit in that, as he says: “The best corn grows under the hill”.

He's not a hero. He's not special. Just another guy who woke up one day in a seriously F**** up situation and said: “Eh, could be worse.”

Some of the features:

  • Fight more than 47 unique enemies (including bosses)

  • 3 enemy types: aliens, robots, and humans experimented on by aliens, now “zombified,” or as he calls them, degenerates

  • 9 upgradeable weapons with their own personality

  • Level editor

  • 4-player co-op arena mode against endless enemy waves (yep, that's what the level editor is for)

  • Alcohol, swearing, farting, and tons of "inappropriate" stuff

  • A healing system where you can overheal… and end up drunk

  • Around 8 hours of main gameplay, and about 35 hours to max out everything and unlock all achievements
